correctness.rationale: Theorem on the explicitly defined 18-vertex cubic Pappus incidence graph. The published degree lower bound yields \(\gamma_{t2}\)≥ceil(36/7)=6, and nine displayed efficient open dominating six-sets attain it. Direct incidence inspection enumerates the exact 3x3 total-domination grid; a triangle/square-free private-neighbor argument proves each is isolated from every one-vertex replacement. Independent standalone LCF/bitmask and Levi/set implementations exhaust all \(\binom{18}{6}=18564\) states, agree on 297 semitotal minima, 1026 jump edges, 432 slide edges, components 9 singles+288, jump radius/diameter 6/6, and slide radius/diameter 8/10. A third standalone verifier enumerates 216 automorphisms and confirms five orbits with degree pairs. Source and actual outputs are delivered; assertions and all-pairs BFS certify this finite graph only.

originality.rationale: Checked exact-state and implication-level novelty, not just titles. Foundational semitotal references contain the definition, general bounds and other families; indexed same-host work on domination, locating codes, matching complexes, matchings and colouring does not determine the semitotal six-set exchange graph. The nine efficient total sets alone are not asserted to be new. Complete 297-state classification, mobile sector, sharp two-rule distances and orbit classes are not covered by inspected sources. Full text of one 2014 potentially relevant generalized characterization is inaccessible, and unpublished/unindexed coverage remains a risk.
residual_risks: The full text of Henning–Marcon 2014 was not accessible through open sources; comparison is abstract-level only.
Indexed databases and public search do not establish universal absence of earlier private or unindexed finite enumerations.
The exact nine efficient open dominating sets may be present in older domination literature; they are not the asserted standalone novelty.

value.rationale: The natural interpolation between domination and total domination motivates asking which minimum semitotal configurations remain mobile. On the canonical Pappus incidence graph, nine geometrically explicit efficient total placements are frozen in both exchange models while 288 non-total minima form a single mobile sector. Sharp 6 versus 10 diameters, exact 3x3 geometry, five symmetry orbits, and a general EOD rigidity lemma provide structural information not supplied by \(\gamma_{t2}\) alone. These are motivated finite invariants and a meaningful reconfiguration boundary, not arbitrary parameters.
